fields.why: Rates and rate changes are reported and ranked ('highest', 'largest') across 5 race/ethnicity groups, 6 urbanization levels and the sex-by-age cells.

The text ranks the sex × age cells as one set ('largest relative change among females aged 15–24', 'largest absolute change among males aged 25–44 and 45–64'), so sex enters by rule 3; region and state are geography, not SPDs.

The z-tests and the gamma CI-overlap rule are stated only for 2016 vs 2017 changes within each group (rule 6: no entry), so the cross-group 'highest/largest' claims carry no test; the three mechanical flags are false alarms.
